name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola Petrović's journey into motorsport began in his father's small machine shop in Belgrade, where he spent countless hours tinkering with engines and welding metal. His passion quickly shifted from general mechanics to the specialized world of racing after attending a local rally event. Nikola honed his fabrication skills through years of working on custom car builds and race-prep for smaller teams, gradually building a reputation for precision and resourcefulness.

Joining Dick Johnson Racing was a dream come true for Nikola. He prides himself on his ability to diagnose and solve complex mechanical issues quickly and efficiently, often finding innovative solutions using limited resources. His pragmatic approach ensures that the team can keep their cars on the track and competitive, even under challenging circumstances. Nikola's colleagues respect his quiet dedication and ability to deliver results, making him a valuable asset to the team.
